task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into Odoo with admin credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Odoo dashboard or Calendar app is visible, and the user avatar/name 'admin' is shown in the top right corner.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the Calendar application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The screen shows the Odoo Calendar view (grid of days/hours).

task_completion.description: Agent opens the event creation modal and enters the title.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A modal or sidebar is open with the 'Meeting Subject' or 'Event Name' field containing 'Weekly Team Standup'.

task_completion.description: The event is set to start next Monday at 9:00 AM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The date picker or time field shows the date of the upcoming Monday (relative to the current system date) and a start time of 09:00.

task_completion.description: The event duration is set to 30 minutes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Duration' field shows '00:30' or the end time is set to 09:30.

task_completion.description: The event is configured to repeat weekly.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Recurrent' checkbox is checked, and the recurrence rule is set to 'Weekly' in the event details or 'Options' tab.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo web interface rather than executing database commands or scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on UI elements, and typing into form fields within the browser.

integrity.description: The agent did not use a terminal to bypass the UI for event creation.
integrity.visual_evidence: No terminal windows are used to execute python scripts or psql commands to insert records directly.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the Odoo menus to reach the Calendar.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the transition from the main dashboard/app switcher to the Calendar module.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires creating a recurring event in Odoo 17. The 'next Monday' date depends on the current system date shown in the UI. The recurrence settings in Odoo are typically found under an 'Options' tab or a 'Recurrent' checkbox within the event creation modal. The credentials are admin/admin.
